exposure: Maternal pre-eclampsia-like syndrome induced by NG-nitro-L-arginine methyl ester (L-NAME) during gestation
outcome: Neuroepithelial cell proliferation in fetal hippocampus
Offspring cognitive and learning capabilities (Morris water maze test: escape latency, swimming distance)
Hippocampal glucocorticoid receptor (GR) expression in offspring
cohort: Pregnant rats (n=32) administered either L-NAME or saline from the 13th day of gestation until parturition, and their adolescent offspring.
finding: Maternal pre-eclampsia-like syndrome impaired cognitive and learning capabilities and increased hippocampal glucocorticoid receptor expression in adolescent rat offspring.
